title: Leighterton to Westonbirt Walk Walking Route

images.title: Westonbirt Arboretum [24] by Michael Dibb, CC BY-SA 2.0 <https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0>, via Wikimedia Commons
images.caption: Westonbirt Arboretum

description: This walk takes you from the rural village of Leighterton to the splendid Westonbirt Arboretum. The route runs for a distance of just under 2 miles, following a section of the Monarch's Way from the village to the site in a south easterly direction. You'll pass through some fine countryside before coming to the visitor centre of the Arboretum. The 600-acre arboretum is home to 15,000 tree specimens from around the globe, making it one of the UK's most important and valuable tree collections. It offers a breathtaking spectacle in autumn with its vibrant colours, while spring brings beautiful displays of rhododendrons, azaleas, magnolias, wildflowers, bluebells, and cherry trees across its various sections.
